name: Mr D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股息派发、股东大会及关联交易授权等常规企业事项，未披露各业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered routine corporate matters such as dividend payments, general meetings and related party transaction mandates, with no disclosure of expansion, new business, reduction or contract information for any business segment.
